terms.grammar: adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)
terms.comment: The ninth month, counting from March. Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Novembrēs: the 1st, 5th and 13th.

phrases.latin: concipiunt Novembrī mēnse, ut Mārtiō pariant turgēscentibus virgultīs
phrases.english: goats conceive in November, so as to give birth in March, when the shoots are swelling

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 77, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
